interactiveObjects.name: The Cadmean Stone Portal
interactiveObjects.unpickableReason: A monumental limestone slab counterweighted with ancient gears. It has no keyhole and cannot be picked; it yields only to the spoken name of the guardian.
interactiveObjects.description: A heavy stone slab inscribed with archaic Cadmean letters and a coiled serpent relief.

interactiveObjects.name: Wayfarer's Stone Offering Box
interactiveObjects.description: A hollowed limestone niche beneath the Hermaion cairn where pious travelers leave gifts.
